command_line:
set -eu
cat > fit_colony.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]
diagfile <- args[[3]]

dat <- read.csv(infile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
dat$StrainNumber <- as.character(dat$StrainNumber)
ratio_parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(dat$Ratio, ':', fixed = TRUE))
left <- as.numeric(ratio_parts[, 1])
right <- as.numeric(ratio_parts[, 2])

dat$p <- NA_real_
mixture <- dat$StrainNumber == '287_98'
dat$p[mixture] <- left[mixture] / (left[mixture] + right[mixture])
dat$p[dat$StrainNumber == '287'] <- 1
dat$p[dat$StrainNumber == '98'] <- 0
fitdat <- dat[!is.na(dat$p) & !is.na(dat$Area), c('DishNumber', 'StrainNumber', 'Ratio', 'Replicate', 'Area', 'p')]
fitdat$Area <- as.numeric(fitdat$Area)

models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = fitdat),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = fitdat),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(p, df = 4), data = fitdat)
)
model_names <- names(models)
aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- model_names[which.min(aics)]
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

obj <- function(x) {
  -as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(p = x)))
}
opt <- optimize(obj, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = FALSE)
opt_p <- opt$minimum
max_area <- -opt$objective

answer <- data.frame(
  best_model = best_name,
  optimum_proportion_287 = opt_p,
  predicted_max_area = max_area,
  n_rows = nrow(fitdat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(answer, file = outfile, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

diag <- data.frame(
  model = model_names,
  df = vapply(models, function(m) attr(logLik(m), 'df'), numeric(1)),
  AIC = as.numeric(aics),
  nobs = vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(diag, file = diagfile, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
